==Biography==
===2015 Preseason===
On October 23, '''Jesiz''' announced his departure from [[SK Gaming]] and free agency,<ref>[http://twitter.com/Jesizlol/status/525344525917900801 Jesiz's Twitter] ''twitter.com''</ref> and on October 27, it was announced that he would be replacing [[LOD]] as the midlaner for [[Team Coast]]. At the same time, [[Impaler]] from [[Supa Hot Crew]] joined Coast replacing [[Santorin]] in the jungle.

Coast had given up their Expansion Tournament qualification due to losing three members of the team that had played in the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Promotion|Promotion Tournament]]. However, they qualified via the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Expansion/Challenger Ladder|Challenger ladder]] with the top seed, ahead of [[Enemy eSports]]. Coast easily went through the online stage of the tournament, defeating [[Call Gaming]] and [[Team LoLPro|LoLPro]] both 2-0. Matched against [[Curse Academy]] in the live tournament, they lost in the first round 3-1 but then beat [[Final 5]] 3-1 and [[Team Fusion]] 3-2 and qualified for the [[Riot League Championship Series/North America/2015 Season/Spring Season|Spring 2015 LCS]]. Their starting roster going into the 2015 season included [[Cris]], [[Impaler]], Jesiz, [[DontMashMe|Mash]], and [[Sheep (Jamie Gallagher)|Sheep]].

===2015 Season===
At a 1-7 record after the fourth week of play, Coast replaced Jesiz with [[mancloud]]. However, they lost all of their remaining games and ended the split with a 1-17 record, automatically relegated to the [[2015 NA Challenger Series/Summer Season|NACS]].
He later joined [[Team Dignitas]] as an analyst.

===2016 Preseason===
Jesiz substituted for [[Team Dignitas]]'s support [[KiWiKiD]] at [[IEM Season X - Cologne|IEM Cologne]] in November 2015. Seeded against [[Qiao Gu Reapers]] in the first round, the team lost 1-2 and were eliminated.

===2016 Season===
In May, Jesiz joined [[Immortals]] as assistant coach.<ref name="JesizAssistantCoach">[http://www.facebook.com/gg.Immortals/posts/1565509023743614:0 Jesiz joins as Assistant Coach] ''facebook.com''</ref>
